description: Episode-01 sequel dialogue, written in the game's own double-byte font codes (not cp932). Text here is plain Chinese; tools/text_codec.py encodes it. Every character must exist in the ROM font or the build fails.

entries.notes: Same-length proof-of-write at the pre-pointer-table region 0x00076D. Slot is 4 bytes = 2 font codes, so the label stays two characters. Renders as 开始.

entries.text:
边境情报异常
小队被派往警戒线 V20261020
entries.notes: Episode-01 opening line (story beat ep01_intro: 木叶边境巡逻情报异常，主角小队被临时派往南部警戒线). The ASCII run id V20261020 is a grep anchor for E2E ROM verification.

entries.text:
山道遭遇不明忍者
敌方企图夺取运输卷轴！
entries.notes: Episode-01 encounter line (story beat ep01_battle: 在山道遭遇身份不明的忍者部队，敌方试图夺取运输卷轴).

entries.text:
保护运输卷轴！
击退来袭的忍者部队！
entries.notes: Episode-01 battle objective line. Carries the ep01_battle beat into the battle screen.
Episode-01 chapter label. Slot is 6 bytes = 3 font codes.
